wikidot5e:spell:chill-touch.effectSummary: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature in range. On a hit it takes 1d8 necrotic damage and cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn. If the target is undead, it also has disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the end of your next turn. Damage becomes 2d8 at character level 5, 3d8 at level 11, and 4d8 at level 17.

wikidot5e:spell:chromatic-orb.effectSummary: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder and make a ranged spell attack against a visible creature in range. On a hit it takes 3d8 damage of the chosen type. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d8 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:circle-of-death.effectSummary: Each creature in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a point in range makes a Constitution save, taking 8d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Each slot level above 6th adds 2d6 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:circle-of-power.effectSummary: A 30-foot-radius sphere moves with you. Friendly creatures in it, including you, have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. If an affected creature succeeds on a save against a spell or magical effect that normally deals half damage on a success, it takes no damage instead.

wikidot5e:spell:clairvoyance.effectSummary: Create an invisible, stationary sensor within 1 mile at either a location familiar to you or an obvious location that is unfamiliar. Choose sight or hearing when casting and perceive through that sense as though you occupied the sensor's space; as an action, switch between the two senses. The sensor cannot be attacked or interacted with. A creature able to see invisible things perceives it as a luminous intangible orb about fist-sized.

wikidot5e:spell:clone.effectSummary: Grow an inert duplicate of a living creature in the required vessel. The clone reaches full size and maturity after 120 days; you may choose a younger physical version, and once mature it remains inert indefinitely while the vessel is undisturbed. If the original later dies, its soul transfers to the mature clone if the soul is free and willing. The clone has the original's physical identity, personality, memories, and abilities but none of its equipment. Any remaining corpse of the original then becomes inert and cannot be restored to life because its soul is now elsewhere.

wikidot5e:spell:cloud-of-daggers.effectSummary: Fill a 5-foot cube centered on a point in range with spinning daggers. A creature takes 4d4 slashing damage when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there. Each slot level above 2nd adds 2d4 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:cloudkill.effectSummary: Create a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous fog centered within range. It spreads around corners, heavily obscures its area, and lasts until concentration ends or strong wind disperses it. A creature entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Constitution save, taking 5d8 poison damage on a failure or half on a success; holding breath or not needing to breathe gives no protection. At the start of each of your turns the fog moves 10 feet directly away from you along the ground, sinking to the lowest available level and pouring through openings. Each slot level above 5th adds 1d8 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:color-spray.effectSummary: Roll 6d10 to determine a hit-point pool. In a 15-foot cone, consider conscious creatures that can see, ordered from lowest current HP upward. A creature is blinded until the end of your next turn if its current HP is no greater than the remaining pool; subtract its HP and continue to the next creature. Stop when the next creature's HP exceeds the remaining pool. Each slot level above 1st adds 2d10 to the pool roll.

wikidot5e:spell:command.effectSummary: Speak a one-word command to a visible creature in range. It makes a Wisdom save or follows the command on its next turn. The spell has no effect on undead, a creature that does not understand your language, or a directly harmful command; if the target cannot follow the command, the spell ends. Typical commands: Approach—move by the shortest route toward you and end its turn once within 5 feet; Drop—drop what it holds and end its turn; Flee—spend the turn moving away by the fastest available means; Grovel—fall prone and end its turn; Halt—do not move or take actions, with a flying creature remaining aloft if possible and moving only the minimum needed to stay airborne. Other commands are adjudicated by the DM. Each slot level above 1st adds one target, and all targets must be within 30 feet of one another.
